testCases.summary: [DE][PRGM] Create an OOS Data API for a Supplier Instance

scenarios.title: API returns OOS data for store with scans in specific category
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And Store 1234 has distribution lists for oral care and grooming categories
And user has taken photos in oral care category on July 1
And user has NOT taken photos in grooming category on July 1
And OOS data exists for oral care products in Store 1234

steps.action: When client sends GET request to OOS Data API with store_number=1234 and date=2024-07-01
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 status code

steps.action: Then response contains OOS data for oral care category only
steps.expectedResult: Response includes Store Number, Store Name, Scan Date, EAN, Product Name, User response, Assortment Flag for oral care products

steps.action: And response does NOT contain grooming category data
steps.expectedResult: No grooming products appear in response since no scans occurred

steps.action: Then all returned records have scan_date matching July 1
steps.expectedResult: All records show date field as 2024-07-01

scenarios.expectedResult: API returns OOS data only for categories where scans occurred, filtering out categories without scans

scenarios.title: API returns complete OOS data for store with scans in all categories
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And Store 2345 has distribution lists for multiple categories
And user has taken photos in all categories on July 1
And OOS data exists for all categories in Store 2345

steps.action: When client sends GET request to OOS Data API with store_number=2345 and date=2024-07-01
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 status code

steps.action: Then response contains OOS data for all categories
steps.expectedResult: Response includes records for oral care, grooming, and all other categories with scans

steps.action: And each record contains all required fields
steps.expectedResult: Each record has Store Number, Store Name, Scan Date, EAN, Product Name, User response, Assortment Flag populated

steps.action: Then all EAN values are valid product identifiers
steps.expectedResult: EAN field contains numeric barcode values matching product database

scenarios.expectedResult: API returns complete OOS dataset for store with scans across all categories, including all required data fields
scenarios.automationHint: REST Assured: Verify response schema matches expected structure; assert all required fields are non-null; validate EAN format is numeric;

scenarios.title: API returns empty result for store with no scans on specified date
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And Store 9876 exists in the system
And Store 9876 has NO scans on July 1
And Store 9876 may have scans on other dates

steps.action: When client sends GET request to OOS Data API with store_number=9876 and date=2024-07-01
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 status code

steps.action: Then response contains empty data array
steps.expectedResult: Response body shows empty array or no records: {"data": [], "count": 0}

steps.action: And response includes metadata indicating no scans found
steps.expectedResult: Response metadata shows message: 'No scans found for specified store and date'

scenarios.expectedResult: API returns empty result set for stores without scans on the specified date, confirming filter logic works correctly

scenarios.title: API rejects request with invalid store number format
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And API expects numeric store_number parameter

steps.action: When client sends GET request with invalid store_number='INVALID_STORE'
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request status code

steps.action: Then response contains error message describing validation failure
steps.expectedResult: Error message states: 'Invalid store_number format. Expected numeric value.'

steps.action: And response includes error code for client handling
steps.expectedResult: Response contains error_code field for programmatic error handling

scenarios.expectedResult: API rejects invalid store number with clear error message and appropriate HTTP status code

scenarios.title: API rejects request with missing required authentication
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API requires authentication
And valid JWT token or API key is required for access

steps.action: When client sends GET request without authentication token
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 401 Unauthorized status code

steps.action: Then response contains authentication error message
steps.expectedResult: Error message states: 'Authentication required. Please provide valid credentials.'

steps.action: And no OOS data is returned in response
steps.expectedResult: Response body contains only error information, no data field present

scenarios.expectedResult: API enforces authentication requirement and rejects unauthenticated requests with 401 status

scenarios.title: API handles request for non-existent store number
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And store number 99999 does not exist in the system

steps.action: When client sends GET request with store_number=99999
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 404 Not Found or 200 with empty data

steps.action: Then response indicates store not found or no data available
steps.expectedResult: Response message states: 'Store not found' or returns empty data array

steps.action: And response does not expose internal system errors
steps.expectedResult: Error message is user-friendly without technical stack traces

scenarios.expectedResult: API gracefully handles non-existent store numbers without exposing system internals
scenarios.automationHint: REST Assured: Verify response does not contain stack traces or database error messages; assert clean error handling;

scenarios.title: API returns correct data structure matching sample file format
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And sample file format defines required columns
And Store has OOS data with scans available

steps.action: When client sends valid GET request to OOS Data API
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 status code

steps.action: Then response contains all required fields from sample file
steps.expectedResult: Each record includes: Store Number, Store Name, Scan Date, EAN, Product Name, User response, Assortment Flag

steps.action: And field data types match expected format
steps.expectedResult: Store Number is numeric, Scan Date is date format, EAN is string, Assortment Flag is boolean or Y/N

steps.action: Then field names match sample file column headers
steps.expectedResult: JSON keys or CSV headers exactly match sample file specification

scenarios.expectedResult: API response structure matches sample file format with all required columns and correct data types
scenarios.automationHint: REST Assured: Validate JSON schema against expected structure; assert field names match specification; verify data types using JsonSchemaValidator;

scenarios.title: API handles date boundary at midnight for scan filtering
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And Store has scans at 23:59:59 on June 30
And Store has scans at 00:00:01 on July 1
And timezone is configured for store location

steps.action: When client requests OOS data for date=2024-07-01
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 status code

steps.action: Then response includes scans from 00:00:01 onwards on July 1
steps.expectedResult: Scans timestamped after midnight July 1 are included

steps.action: And response excludes scans from 23:59:59 on June 30
steps.expectedResult: Scans before midnight are not included in July 1 results

steps.action: Then date filtering respects store timezone
steps.expectedResult: Midnight boundary is calculated based on store's configured timezone

scenarios.expectedResult: API correctly handles date boundaries at midnight, filtering scans by exact date with timezone awareness
scenarios.automationHint: REST Assured: Test with scans at boundary timestamps; verify timezone handling; assert correct date filtering logic;

scenarios.title: API handles large result set with multiple categories and products
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And Store has scans in 10+ categories on specified date
And each category has 50+ OOS products
And total result set exceeds 500 records

steps.action: When client requests OOS data for store with large dataset
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 status code

steps.action: Then response returns within acceptable time threshold (under 5 seconds)
steps.expectedResult: API response time is less than 5000ms

steps.action: And response includes pagination metadata if applicable
steps.expectedResult: Response contains total_count, page, page_size fields for large datasets

steps.action: Then all records are returned or pagination links provided
steps.expectedResult: Either complete dataset returned or next_page URL provided for pagination

scenarios.expectedResult: API handles large result sets efficiently with acceptable performance and proper pagination support
scenarios.automationHint: REST Assured: Measure response time with .time(lessThan(5000L)); verify pagination metadata; test with large dataset;

scenarios.title: API filters OOS data when store has partial scans across multiple dates
preconditions: Given Store Intelligence API is available and authenticated
And Store 1234 has scans in oral care on July 1
And Store 1234 has scans in grooming on July 2
And Store 1234 has no scans in oral care on July 2

steps.action: When client requests OOS data for store_number=1234 and date=2024-07-01
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 and oral care OOS data only

steps.action: When client requests OOS data for store_number=1234 and date=2024-07-02
steps.expectedResult: API responds with HTTP 200 and grooming OOS data only

steps.action: Then each date request returns only categories with scans on that specific date
steps.expectedResult: Date filtering is independent; each date shows only its scanned categories

steps.action: And no cross-date category data appears in results
steps.expectedResult: July 1 results do not include grooming; July 2 results do not include oral care

scenarios.expectedResult: API correctly filters OOS data by both store and date, showing only categories scanned on each specific date
scenarios.automationHint: REST Assured: Test multiple date queries for same store; verify category filtering is date-specific; assert no cross-contamination;
